ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — Ernest Hemingway — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Mr. Hemingway is a 56-year-old writer with hereditary hemochromatosis on weekly phlebotomy, severe alcohol use disorder with no alcohol for about two months, depression on sertraline 100 mg, hypertension on amlodipine 10 mg, post-concussion symptoms and prediabetes, who comes for his yearly preventive visit seven weeks after his fourteen-week review. His hand healed fully after the antibiotics. He has had seventeen phlebotomy sessions so far, with the eighteenth today, and tolerates them well. He has had no alcohol since he chose to stop, takes naltrexone daily, and has fewer cravings. His mood is better and his PHQ-9 today is 6. His home blood pressure average is 126/78. He has headaches about once a week and is writing every morning again. His guns remain in the locked storage at his shooting club. [S]

tr.td: Seventeen sessions; the eighteenth today; tolerated well
Naltrexone 50 mg, sertraline 100 mg, amlodipine 10 mg and thiamine 100 mg daily

text.paragraph: Immunizations given today: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV20), one dose for chronic liver disease and alcohol use disorder; Recombinant zoster vaccine, dose 1 of 2; Hepatitis A and hepatitis B vaccine, dose 1 of 3, for chronic liver disease after nonreactive hepatitis B tests [S]

Guideline basis: The American Psychiatric Association Practice Guideline for the Pharmacological Treatment of Patients With Alcohol Use Disorder (2018); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and depression, bipolar, and mood disorders monographs (2026); Medicare Preventive Services reference: visit templates, screening cascades, and documentation elements (2026); USPSTF A and B Recommendations (2026); Adult Immunization Schedule by Age (2026)

Follow-up: Six-month review in five weeks with iron studies, liver tests, HbA1c, lipids and the repeat MoCA. Weekly phlebotomy continues. Colonoscopy to be scheduled. Second zoster and hepatitis vaccine doses due. Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 1955-08-31: six-month review: iron, liver, mood, memory and the plan for maintenance phlebotomy. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 18 minutes, with his consent. He named a health care agent, and a health care proxy form was completed; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most to him is being able to think clearly and write, and being outdoors. He chose not to record specific treatment preferences today and asked to return to the subject when his treatment is further along. The plan will be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
